findings.title: Sensitive path publicly accessible: /backup.sql
findings.evidence: HEAD https://127.0.0.1:57672/backup.sql -> 200 (Content-Type: application/octet-stream, Content-Length: 24); database dump. Content NOT downloaded.
findings.remediation: Remove /backup.sql from the web root or deny access at the web server (e.g. nginx `location ~ /\. { deny all; }`). If it held secrets, assume they are compromised and rotate them.

findings.title: Sensitive path publicly accessible: /.env
findings.evidence: HEAD https://127.0.0.1:57672/.env -> 200 (Content-Type: application/octet-stream, Content-Length: 24); environment file (typically DB passwords, API keys). Content NOT downloaded.
findings.remediation: Remove /.env from the web root or deny access at the web server (e.g. nginx `location ~ /\. { deny all; }`). If it held secrets, assume they are compromised and rotate them.

findings.title: AngularJS 1.5.8 has 1 known vulnerability
findings.evidence: AngularJS 1.5.8 at https://127.0.0.1:57672/static/js/app.js. GHSA-5cp4-xmrw-59wf (CVE-2019-10768) [High 9.8]: XSS via JSONP / prototype pollution in AngularJS
findings.remediation: Upgrade AngularJS to the latest release (check each advisory's fixed version on https://osv.dev/list?ecosystem=npm&q=angular) and remove unused copies. Consider Subresource Integrity for CDN-hosted files.

findings.title: Sensitive path publicly accessible: /.git/config
findings.evidence: HEAD https://127.0.0.1:57672/.git/config -> 200 (Content-Type: application/octet-stream, Content-Length: 24); Git repository metadata (full source code may be recoverable). Content NOT downloaded.
findings.remediation: Remove /.git/config from the web root or deny access at the web server (e.g. nginx `location ~ /\. { deny all; }`). If it held secrets, assume they are compromised and rotate them.

findings.title: Certificate does not cover the target hostname
findings.remediation: Reissue the certificate with the hostname in the subjectAltName extension.

findings.title: TLS certificate is self-signed
findings.remediation: Use a certificate issued by a publicly trusted CA so clients can authenticate the server.

findings.title: Certificate uses a weak public key
findings.remediation: Reissue with RSA >= 2048 bits (3072 recommended) or ECDSA P-256 or stronger.

findings.title: Server accepts anonymous cipher suites
findings.evidence: negotiated AECDH-AES256-SHA over TLSv1.2 (no server authentication (trivial MITM))
findings.remediation: Restrict the cipher list to AEAD suites with ECDHE key exchange, e.g. Mozilla's 'intermediate' profile (ECDHE+AESGCM, ECDHE+CHACHA20).

findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' lacks the HttpOnly flag
findings.remediation: Add `HttpOnly` so JavaScript (and therefore XSS payloads) cannot read the cookie. Only omit it for cookies the front-end genuinely needs to read.

findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' lacks the Secure flag
findings.remediation: Add `Secure` so the cookie is never sent over plain HTTP. For session cookies, prefer the `__Host-` prefix (requires Secure, Path=/, no Domain).

findings.title: Cookie 'tracking' lacks the Secure flag
findings.remediation: Add `Secure` so the cookie is never sent over plain HTTP. For session cookies, prefer the `__Host-` prefix (requires Secure, Path=/, no Domain).

findings.title: Cookie 'tracking' uses SameSite=None without Secure
findings.remediation: SameSite=None requires Secure; modern browsers reject the cookie otherwise.

findings.title: Bootstrap 3.3.7 has 1 known vulnerability
findings.evidence: Bootstrap 3.3.7 at https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.7/css/bootstrap.min.css. GHSA-4p24-vmcr-4gqj (CVE-2018-14042) [Medium 6.1]: XSS in data-container property of tooltip
findings.remediation: Upgrade Bootstrap to the latest release (check each advisory's fixed version on https://osv.dev/list?ecosystem=npm&q=bootstrap) and remove unused copies. Consider Subresource Integrity for CDN-hosted files.

findings.title: jQuery 1.12.4 has 2 known vulnerabilities
findings.evidence: jQuery 1.12.4 at https://127.0.0.1:57672/static/js/jquery-1.12.4.min.js. GHSA-6c3j-c64m-qhgq (CVE-2019-11358) [Medium 6.1]: XSS in jQuery as used in Drupal, Backdrop CMS, and other products | GHSA-gxr4-xjj5-5px2 (CVE-2020-11022) [Medium 4.7]: Potential XSS vulnerability in jQuery
findings.remediation: Upgrade jQuery to the latest release (check each advisory's fixed version on https://osv.dev/list?ecosystem=npm&q=jquery) and remove unused copies. Consider Subresource Integrity for CDN-hosted files.

findings.title: Directory listing enabled at /uploads/
findings.evidence: GET https://127.0.0.1:57672/uploads/ -> 200, body contains an auto-generated index
findings.remediation: Disable automatic indexes (nginx `autoindex off;`, Apache `Options -Indexes`, IIS directoryBrowse enabled=false).

findings.title: Error pages expose debug information / stack traces
findings.evidence:
GET https://127.0.0.1:57672/sitescan-probe-f55282cb696c -> 404; signatures: Python traceback, Debug mode flag; snippet: html>

Internal error

 Traceback (most recent call last): File "/srv/app/views.py", line 42, in dispatch return handlers[path]() K
findings.remediation: Disable debug mode in production and serve generic error pages; log the details server-side instead. Stack traces reveal paths, frameworks and code structure.

findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-eval' (script-src)
findings.remediation: Remove 'unsafe-eval'. Refactor code that uses eval(), new Function(), or string arguments to setTimeout/setInterval.

findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline' scripts (script-src)
findings.remediation: Remove 'unsafe-inline' from script sources. Move inline scripts to external files, or authorise them with per-response nonces or hashes (browsers that support nonces ignore 'unsafe-inline' when one is present).

findings.title: CSP script sources include wildcard/scheme sources (script-src)
findings.remediation: Replace wildcard and bare-scheme sources (`*`, `https:`, `data:`) with an explicit allow-list of origins, or adopt a nonce + 'strict-dynamic' policy.

findings.title: No clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
findings.evidence: neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors present
findings.remediation: Send `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'` (preferred) and/or `X-Frame-Options: DENY` / `SAMEORIGIN`.

findings.title: Sensitive path publicly accessible: /phpinfo.php
findings.evidence: HEAD https://127.0.0.1:57672/phpinfo.php -> 200 (Content-Type: application/octet-stream, Content-Length: 24); phpinfo() page (full environment disclosure). Content NOT downloaded.
findings.remediation: Remove /phpinfo.php from the web root or deny access at the web server (e.g. nginx `location ~ /\. { deny all; }`). If it held secrets, assume they are compromised and rotate them.

findings.title: TLS certificate expires in 4 days
findings.remediation: Renew now and put certificate expiry under automated renewal + monitoring.

findings.title: Deprecated protocol TLSv1.0 is enabled
findings.evidence: handshake succeeded with TLSv1.0, cipher ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
findings.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1 (deprecated by RFC 8996); support only TLS 1.2 and 1.3.

findings.title: Deprecated protocol TLSv1.1 is enabled
findings.evidence: handshake succeeded with TLSv1.1, cipher ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
findings.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1 (deprecated by RFC 8996); support only TLS 1.2 and 1.3.

findings.title: Active mixed content: 4 HTTP resource(s) on HTTPS page
findings.remediation: Load every script, stylesheet, frame and form target over HTTPS. As a safety net add `Content-Security-Policy: upgrade-insecure-requests`.

findings.title: HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS
findings.remediation: Answer every plain-HTTP request with a 301 to the same host over https://. Redirecting to a different host first breaks HSTS preload eligibility.

findings.title: Cookie 'tracking' lacks the HttpOnly flag
findings.remediation: Add `HttpOnly` so JavaScript (and therefore XSS payloads) cannot read the cookie. Only omit it for cookies the front-end genuinely needs to read.

findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' has no SameSite attribute
findings.remediation: Set `SameSite=Lax` (or `Strict` for session cookies that never need cross-site navigation). Relying on browser defaults is inconsistent across clients.

findings.title: Server header discloses software/version
findings.remediation: Remove or genericise the Server header (e.g. nginx `server_tokens off;`, Apache `ServerTokens Prod` + `ServerSignature Off`, PHP `expose_php = Off`). Version strings let attackers map you to known CVEs instantly.

findings.title: X-Powered-By header discloses software/version
findings.remediation: Remove or genericise the X-Powered-By header (e.g. nginx `server_tokens off;`, Apache `ServerTokens Prod` + `ServerSignature Off`, PHP `expose_php = Off`). Version strings let attackers map you to known CVEs instantly.

findings.title: CSP missing base-uri directive
findings.remediation: Add `base-uri 'self'` (or 'none'). base-uri does not fall back to default-src, so an injected <base> tag can redirect relative script URLs.

findings.title: CSP does not lock down plugin content (object-src)
findings.remediation: Add `object-src 'none'` to block legacy plugin-based script execution.

findings.title: HSTS max-age is shorter than 6 months
findings.remediation: Raise max-age to at least 31536000 (1 year) once HTTPS is stable.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy header missing
findings.remediation: Disable powerful features you don't use, e.g. `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=()`.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy leaks full URLs cross-origin
findings.remediation: Use `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, `same-origin` or `no-referrer`; `unsafe-url` sends paths and query strings (which may hold tokens) to third parties.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff not set
findings.remediation: Send `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Sensitive path publicly accessible: /.DS_Store
findings.evidence: HEAD https://127.0.0.1:57672/.DS_Store -> 200 (Content-Type: application/octet-stream, Content-Length: 24); macOS folder metadata (leaks file names). Content NOT downloaded.
findings.remediation: Remove /.DS_Store from the web root or deny access at the web server (e.g. nginx `location ~ /\. { deny all; }`). If it held secrets, assume they are compromised and rotate them.

findings.title: Server accepts static-RSA cipher suites
findings.evidence: negotiated AES256-GCM-SHA384 over TLSv1.2 (no forward secrecy (RSA key exchange))
findings.remediation: Restrict the cipher list to AEAD suites with ECDHE key exchange, e.g. Mozilla's 'intermediate' profile (ECDHE+AESGCM, ECDHE+CHACHA20).

findings.title: TLS 1.3 is not supported
findings.remediation: Enable TLS 1.3 for faster handshakes and removal of legacy cipher constructions.

findings.title: Passive mixed content: 1 HTTP media resource(s)
findings.remediation: Serve images/media over HTTPS or use protocol-relative/HTTPS URLs.

findings.title: robots.txt advertises potentially sensitive paths
findings.remediation: robots.txt is public and is a roadmap for attackers. Protect sensitive areas with authentication instead of hiding them, and drop them from robots.txt.

findings.title: No security.txt (RFC 9116)
findings.remediation: Publish /.well-known/security.txt with `Contact:` and `Expires:` so researchers can report vulnerabilities to you (generator: https://securitytxt.org).

findings.title: DNS/email checks skipped (IP or local target)
findings.remediation: Pass --dns-domain <domain> to assess the domain's DNS records.

findings.title: Admin interface present (access-controlled): /admin
findings.remediation: Consider restricting admin interfaces to trusted networks in addition to authentication.

findings.title: Probed 35 well-known paths with HEAD
findings.remediation: Informational: full status map of the path probe.

findings.remediation: No action required; informational.

findings.title: Not eligible for the HSTS preload list
findings.evidence: max-age must be >= 31536000 (1 year); missing includeSubDomains; missing preload directive; HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS on the same host
findings.remediation: Preloading protects first visits. Requirements: valid cert, HTTP->HTTPS redirect, HSTS max-age >= 1 year with includeSubDomains and preload.
